hook_text: School closes on 9 December and opens on 14 January. How many days of holiday is that? Hint: it is not 5.
clip_script: Durban, December countdown. School closes 9 December, opens 14 January. Not 14 minus 9! Different months, different years. Step one: to the end of December. December has 31 days, 31 minus 9 is 22 days. Step two: into January, 14 more days. 22 plus 14: 36 days of holiday. Check: a bit more than a month, about 30 days, yes. And the same trick inside a month? 3 March to 10 March is 10 minus 3, 7 days. Count the jumps, not the dates. To the end of the month, whole months, then into the last month.
visual_style: Whiteboard calendar pages for December and January with jumps drawn as arcs; a countdown number ticking up to 36.
pacing: The holiday question, the wrong shortcut, two steps, then the check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count the days until your next birthday.
